title: Free-Transform warp dropped for symbol-internal shapes (sprite.ts doesn't bake warp; only scene timeline does)
description:
SAME DEFECT CLASS as tasks 1228/1230 but on the SPRITE (symbol-internal) publish path instead of the scene timeline. A Free-Transform Distort/Envelope warp authored on a shape that lives INSIDE a movieclip/graphic symbol is DROPPED from the published DefineShape geometry, so the stage shows the warp but the published symbol does not (stage/SWF divergence).

REACHABILITY (confirmed): In symbol-edit / edit-in-place mode, Shell.tsx 'timeline' (~line 751-766) resolves to the edited symbol's timeline (editContext.mode === 'symbol' / editPath). handleShapeWarp (Shell.tsx ~1291-1301) calls withTimeline -> withSymbolTimeline (~698-712), which writes { warp } onto a ShapeDisplayObject inside the symbol's timeline. So obj.warp CAN be non-null on a ShapeDisplayObject that lives inside a DefineSprite symbol.

BYTE PROOF (swf-dump / decoded DefineShape4 ShapeBounds): built a doc with a movieclip symbol containing a 100x100 square shape placed at (50,50) with a Distort warp dragging the SE corner from (150,150) to (300,250), placed an instance on the scene, compiled via exportSWF, and decoded the DefineShape4 inside the DefineSprite:
  - SYMBOL-INTERNAL (defect): bounds = {xMin:1000, xMax:3000, yMin:1000, yMax:3000} twips = a PRISTINE 100x100 square (2000x2000 twips), merely shifted by shiftShapePaths(obj.x,obj.y). The warp is gone.
  - SCENE-LEVEL CONTROL (correct, baked by 1228): same shape+warp on the scene timeline = {xMin:0, xMax:5000, yMin:0, yMax:4000} twips = SE corner baked to (250,200)px origin-relative. Matches warp-bake.test.ts.

ROOT CAUSE: packages/swf/src/sprite.ts ~line 338 in the char-id/definition pre-pass:
    const normShape = shiftShapePaths(obj.shape, ox, oy);
    hoistedDefs.push({ tagType: Tag.DefineShape4, body: encodeDefineShape4(charId, normShape) });
It uses shiftShapePaths(obj.shape, ...) and IGNORES obj.warp entirely, then emits an affine objTransform in the sprite-internal PlaceObject2 (a PO2 matrix is affine and cannot carry a non-affine distort/envelope). The scene path (characters.ts) gates on obj.warp and calls bakeWarpIntoShape (characters.ts ~81-104) -- the sprite path does not. The morph/tween branches in characters.ts (~254-258, 319-320) and the scene shape branch are the only baked paths; the sprite shape-def branch is the gap. The sprite move/place affine-emit lines (~705/936) emit the affine transform that should be gated to identity for warped shapes (mirror the frames.ts ~474/~1069 identity-gating fix from task 1230).

EXPECTED: symbol-internal warp baked into the DefineShape4 inside the DefineSprite exactly like scene shapes (and the sprite-internal PlaceObject2 scale/rotation gated to identity for warped shapes, like 1230's frames.ts fix).
ACTUAL: warp dropped; pristine un-warped DefineShape4 emitted; affine PO2.

FIX DIRECTION: in sprite.ts ~338, when obj.warp is set, emit bakeWarpIntoShape(obj.shape, obj.warp, ox, oy) instead of shiftShapePaths(obj.shape, ox, oy) (note: bakeWarpIntoShape already subtracts x,y so it produces origin-relative geometry; the shapeNormOrigin shift bookkeeping for the residual PO2 translation must be reconciled with the warp bake's built-in -x,-y, same as characters.ts does). Also apply the 1230-style identity gating on the sprite-internal objTransform scale/rotation for warped shapes. Add a regression test mirroring warp-bake.test.ts that decodes the DefineShape4 inside a DefineSprite (assert xMax=5000/yMax=4000 for the distort case). Note this is the same defect class as 1228/1230, on the sprite path.
